items.title: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon says 300,000 workers are needed to rebuild American shipbuilding—with jobs paying $100,000 without a college degree
items.summary: The American Dream now runs through the skilled trades, according to Jamie Dimon—and his bank is investing $24 million to ramp up training in Philadelphia.
items.titleZh: 摩根大通首席执行官杰米·戴蒙表示，重建美国造船业需要30万名工人，而没有大学学位的工作收入为10万美元
items.summaryZh: 杰米·戴蒙表示，美国梦现在贯穿于技术行业，他的银行正在投资2400万美元，以加强在费城的培训。

items.title: Sheryl Sandberg leads $10 million investment in AI-powered vehicle inspection service
items.summary: The startup, founded in 2021, lets enterprise customers use smartphones to scan and spot vehicle damage.

items.title: Short sellers load up against SpaceX as stock retreats back to IPO price
items.summary: About 185 million SpaceX shares are now sold short, representing roughly 29% of the company's publicly tradable float, according to S3.
items.titleZh: 随着股价回落至IPO价格，卖空者纷纷涌向SpaceX
items.summaryZh: 根据S3的数据，目前约有1.85亿股SpaceX股票被卖空，约占该公司公开交易股票的29%。

items.title: Why AMI Labs’ Alexandre LeBrun won't call his AI 'AGI' or 'superintelligence'
items.summary: While everyone in AI is chasing "superintelligence," Alexandre LeBrun, CEO of Yann LeCun’s world model startup, AMI Labs, dismisses the word.
items.titleZh: 为什么AMI实验室的Alexandre LeBrun不会称他的人工智能为“AGI”或“超级智能”
items.summaryZh: 当人工智能领域的每个人都在追求“超级智能”时，Yann LeCun的世界模型初创公司AMI Labs的首席执行官Alexandre LeBrun对这个词不屑一顾。

items.title: 84% of students use AI for homework. Only 3 in 10 schools have rules for it
items.summary: A survey of 435 educators finds AI-detection software misfires as often as it works, leaving teachers unable to verify whether students actually learned.
items.titleZh: 84%的学生使用人工智能做作业。只有十分之三的学校有相关规定
items.summaryZh: 一项针对435名教育工作者的调查发现，人工智能检测软件在工作时经常出现故障，导致教师无法验证学生是否真正学习过。

items.title: Woman discovers a hidden AI camera in her rental car recording her and warning about unsafe driving
items.summary: A woman recently took to social media after discovering that her Audi rental car's dashboard contained a camera recording her every move. It also gave verbal reminders to wear a seat belt and avoid unsafe driving behavior.Read Entire Article
items.titleZh: 一名女子在她的租车中发现了一个隐藏的人工智能摄像头，记录了她并警告了不安全驾驶
items.summaryZh: 一名女子最近在社交媒体上发现，她租来的奥迪汽车的仪表板上有一个摄像头，记录下了她的一举一动。它还口头提醒人们系好安全带，避免不安全的驾驶行为。阅读整篇文章

items.title: AT&T built an AI system to prevent network outages. It reduced customer downtime by more than 12 million hours.
items.summary: AT&T's AI-powered incident management system minimizes outages and prevents millions of unnecessary field dispatches to boost service efficiency.
items.titleZh: AT&T建立了一个人工智能系统来防止网络中断。它将客户停机时间减少了1200多万小时。
items.summaryZh: AT&T的人工智能事件管理系统最大限度地减少了中断，并防止了数百万不必要的现场调度，以提高服务效率。

items.title: Apple Intelligence approved for launch in China with Alibaba and Baidu
items.summary: The deal, which was rumored to be in the works last year, marks an important step for Apple's AI ambitions in a key market.

items.title: Meta Oversight Board study: AI chatbots may be the most perfect propaganda machine ever invented
items.summary: The study found bots even answer differently based on language too — ChatGPT calls China "not a democracy" in English, but hedges in Chinese.
items.titleZh: 元监督委员会的研究：人工智能聊天机器人可能是有史以来发明的最完美的宣传机器
items.summaryZh: 研究发现，机器人甚至会根据语言做出不同的回答——ChatGPT用英语称中国“不是民主国家”，但用中文进行模糊限制。

items.title: Trump insists ‘Iran is unhappy right now’ while venting about ‘electric catapults that don’t work’ at defense tech summit
items.summary: After a long aside about the use of magnets to improve catapults on vessels, Trump finally offered, “I hope I'm not boring anybody.”
items.titleZh: 特朗普坚称“伊朗现在不高兴”，同时在国防技术峰会上对“不起作用的电动弹射器”表示不满
items.summaryZh: 在长时间搁置使用磁铁来改进船只上的弹射器之后，特朗普终于提出：“我希望我没有让任何人感到无聊。”
